title: Tool
description: A software artifact that supervises AI coding agents.

items.description:
How a Tool is deployed / consumed.

Multi-valued: a tool can ship as several surfaces (e.g. Semgrep is
cli + ci_app + library). Orthogonal to ControlParadigm /
TemporalPhase / AutonomyLevel — those describe what the tool does;
this describes how a caller wires it in.

integration_surfaces.description: How this tool is deployed / consumed. Multi-valued — a tool can ship as several surfaces (e.g. cli + ci_app + library).

feeds_into.description: Directed composition. A feeds_into B means A's output is consumed by B.

supervises_targets.description: Library / language / ecosystem the tool watches over.

stars.description: GitHub stargazer count, refreshed periodically by validator/fetch_github_stars.py.

stars_updated_at.description: Date the stars count was last fetched (YYYY-MM-DD).

source.description: Where this node came from (e.g. 'manual', 'pipeline-v0.1', 'import-from-awesome-list'). Single-valued for backwards compatibility; v2 nodes additionally populate ``discovery_sources`` with the full multi-source list.

extractor_model.description: LLM identifier that produced the structured draft (e.g. 'Kimi-K2.5').

extractor_confidence.description: Overall LLM confidence attached to the extraction payload (0-1).

rerank_score.description: Cohere rerank score used to prioritize this candidate (0-1).

candidate_id.description: Link back to candidate_tools.id (or equivalent) in Postgres.

reviewer.description: GitHub handle of the person who merged the node.

discovery_sources.description: Multi-source attribution from Stage 1 discovery. Values are short source identifiers (e.g. 's2', 'github', 'arxiv', 'elicit', 'perplexity', 'awesome-list'). When the same candidate is surfaced by several sources, all are listed — useful for the corroboration signal at Stage 4.

failure_mode_hits.description: FM ids whose Stage 0b synonym queries surfaced this candidate. Used by per-FM coverage metrics (Stage 14) and to flag candidates whose discovery FM hits don't match their final ``addresses_failure_modes``.

prompt_version.description: Pinned identifier of the Kimi extraction prompt (e.g. 'kimi-extract-v0.4.2'). Lets us bulk re-run extraction against newer prompts and diff vs the live YAML.

schema_version.description: Schema version this node was extracted/validated against (e.g. '0.1'). Distinct from the runtime Pydantic schema — this is the contract version captured at extraction time.

provenance.description: How this tool entered the KG. Optional on pre-existing nodes; newly-graduated tools must populate this.

justification.description: Why the auto-tier is wrong. Required so future readers (or new curators) can reproduce or revisit the decision.

by.description: GitHub handle of the curator who set the override.

maturity_override.description: Curator override for the auto-computed maturity tier (Stage 9 of the v2 ingestion pipeline). When present, downstream consumers use ``override.tier`` instead of ``compute_maturity(tool).tier``. Required to carry a justification — overrides are auditable, not invisible.
